title: feat(console): a caller without Studio access is told so, at the URL they opened (objectui#12035)
body:
Fixes #12035

Clause-②: yes

A caller without Studio access who opens a Studio URL is now told so, at the URL they opened, in their language. Before this, the `/studio` entry gate sent them home with no word of why, so a missing capability read exactly like a broken link (objectui#11794 item 5, split to this card by triage). Who may enter Studio is unchanged.

Dispatched by the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat (objectui#10217), PM session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CijGnfWLxTLUFcJkY2ouUw`, claim comment 6078418546 on the card.

## What changed

- `apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx`, `RequireStudioAccess` only. The decision is the same: `holdsStudioAccess`, the pending branch (`LoadingFallback`) and the failed branch (`LoadingScreen` with Retry) are untouched. The non-holder branch used to return a `Navigate` element to `redirectTo ?? homePath`. It now renders a new module-private `StudioAccessRequired` in place: a lock icon, one sentence (`console.studio.accessRequired`) and a "Back to home" link (`Button asChild` over a router `Link`) to `homeTo ?? homePath`, which is the same target the redirect used (the declared landing, objectui#7373, or the launcher where none is declared). The builder is still never mounted for a non-holder, so its lazy chunk is never requested.
- The optional prop `redirectTo` is renamed `homeTo`, because nothing redirects any more. Nothing passes it (`git grep` finds no caller), and `@object-ui/console` does not export the component: its package `exports` is `plugin.js` only.
- `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: one new key, `console.studio.accessRequired`, in all ten packs, beside `console.studio.title` (H4 below). en: "You need Studio access to open Studio."
- Tests: `StudioRoute.test.tsx` (the refusal cases now assert the sentence, an unmoved URL and where the way home leads; the objectui#7373 cases click it), a new `StudioRoute.accessNotice-12035.test.tsx` (the sentence in each of the ten packs, plus the holder control in en and zh), and two sibling pins that used the old redirect as their "the gate has decided" signal (`StudioRoute.lazyBuilder-11798`, `StudioRoute.recentPackage-11863`). What those two pin is unchanged.
- `content/docs/guide/console.md`: one Key Features row, "Studio Access". The guide did not describe the gate before. AGENTS.md rule #2 asks for it, and the claim names the console guide.
- `.changeset/12035-studio-access-notice.md`: `@object-ui/i18n` minor and `@object-ui/console` patch. The new pack key is the only widening of a published surface here, so the package that carries it takes at least minor, as `.changeset/11605-i18n-view-no-object.md` grades its one new key. The console's change moves no published surface.

**Clause-②: yes (widening).** The exported `en` pack and the `TranslationKeys` type derived from it gain one member, `console.studio.accessRequired`. No key is removed or renamed. The way home reuses `empty.appAccessDeniedHome`, so exactly one key is added, as the card's ruling asks.

## H2: where the sentence goes. Measured: in place of the redirect (shape a)

The console's three existing permission refusals all render in place:

| Surface | Shape |
|---|---|
| `AppContent`, an app the session may not open (`empty.appAccessDenied`) | In place, URL kept. Title, description and a "Back to home" button to `useHomePath()`. No Retry ("retrying a permission decision cannot change it"). |
| `MarketplaceAccessDenied` | In place. Lock icon, title, description, back-home button. |
| `RecordDetailView`, a refused record read (`empty.recordAccessDenied`) | In place. Lock icon, title, description. |

`RequireAiSurface`, the sibling the guard's docblock called "same posture", is not a permission refusal. It is an availability gate: on a runtime that serves no agent, a stale bookmark or external link is sent home silently (`RedirectWithSplash`). It says nothing, so it gives no pattern for a notice. What the two gates share, and what this change keeps, is "home, not a dead end".

Shape (b) keeps the redirect and has the landing render the sentence. It has no precedent here. No landing surface reads a refusal reason from router state or from the URL. The console's only `location.state` readers are `RecordDetailView`'s `from` and `StudioDesignSurface`'s run landing. The landing is `useHomePath()`, so it is either `/home` (the launcher) or `/apps/APP` (a declared landing), which means at least two new reader sites. Router state persists in `history.state` across a reload, so reloading the landing would repeat a refusal that is no longer happening. A URL parameter would ride a shared `/home` link to someone the refusal is not about.

Shape (a) reuses the `empty.appAccessDenied` screen's shape and touches one file. The URL stays, so the caller can send it to an administrator and reload once access is granted. A reload or a shared link re-runs the same decision for whoever opens it. **Chosen: (a).** The way home is that screen's own label, `empty.appAccessDeniedHome`.

## Evidence

### Real browser

Chromium at `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, headless, 1280x800. Target: the console's Vite dev server for this branch at `bf3ced6` (`64d2062` changes only two test files). Its `/api` proxy pointed at a stand-in HTTP server that answers a signed-in session and a `GET /api/v1/auth/me/permissions` set with or without `studio.access`. ⚠️ This is not a real objectstack runtime: the gate reads only that endpoint, and the stand-in answers it the two ways the runtime does.

| Case | URL opened | URL after | What the page shows |
|---|---|---|---|
| BEFORE, `main` `5275d1f`, non-holder, en | `/studio` | `/home` | The launcher ("No applications yet"). Nothing about Studio. |
| after, non-holder, en | `/studio` | `/studio` | "You need Studio access to open Studio." and a link "Back to home", href `/home`. Clicking it lands on `/home`. |
| after, non-holder, zh | `/studio/hotcrm/data` | `/studio/hotcrm/data` | "你需要 Studio 访问权限才能打开 Studio。" and "返回首页", href `/home`. `html lang` is `zh`. |
| CONTROL, after, holder, en | `/studio` | `/studio` | The Studio front door ("App Builder", package cards), header with search. No notice. |

No page errors in any of the four runs.

### Tests (final run at `64d2062`)

`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` from the repo root, under the shared verify lock, over:

- every test that names `RequireStudioAccess`, `StudioRoute`, `studioRoutes`, `console.studio.accessRequired` or `empty.appAccessDeniedHome` (`git grep -l`): 8 console files and 4 app-shell files;
- `AppContent.deniedVsUnpublished.test.tsx`, the reused label's own screen;
- `packages/i18n/` (the ten packs' parity tests);
- the whole `scripts/__tests__/` suite.

Result: `Test Files  274 passed | 2 skipped (276)`, `Tests  6919 passed | 15 skipped (6934)`, lock verdict `command-exit 0`.

### Reverse verification

The fix was committed first (`64d2062`). The mutation ran through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, inside a script with its own `trap` restore. The anchor `return` of `StudioAccessRequired` was replaced by the old `Navigate` return. Measured on disk: anchor 1 to 0, replacement 0 to 1, blob `9cc472a5` to `e3b400cc`.

Running `StudioRoute.test.tsx` and `StudioRoute.accessNotice-12035.test.tsx` on that tree: **`Tests  17 failed | 24 passed (41)`**, red in the expected direction. The 17 are the 7 refusal cases and the 10 per-language cases. The 24 that stay green are the holder controls, the loading and failed states, the unauthenticated case, the policy units and the translation sanity checks.

Restore: blob after restore `9cc472a5` equals the blob at `HEAD`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

### Bytes (H3)

`vite build` of `apps/console` on two worktrees, under the lock: `main` `5275d1f` against this branch (`bf3ced6`; `64d2062` adds no bundle input). Read from each build's `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`:

| | eager closure, gzipped |
|---|---|
| `main` `5275d1f` | 3,239,379 B |
| this branch | 3,239,625 B |
| delta | **+246 B** (+754 B raw) |

The ceiling is `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` = 3,281,467, which leaves 41,842 B of headroom on this branch. The `index` chunk takes +203 B (the gate's new branch) and `i18n-locale-en` +22 B (the en row). Every other chunk moves by 12 B or less, as minification and hash jitter. `pnpm check:eager-closure` exits 0 on both builds ("3163.5 KB" on `main`, "3163.7 KB" here, against "3204.6 KB"). Every per-chunk ceiling is unchanged and green.

### H4: the key's home

`console.studio.*` is the block the Studio entry module already reads: `console.studio.title`, the landing's crumb (objectui#11863 Q1). `RequireStudioAccess` had no strings of its own before. The new row sits beside `title` in all ten packs. `all-locales-key-parity` and the rest of `packages/i18n/` are green in the run above.

## Acceptance notes

- **Pending changesets read against this diff.** I read `.changeset/11863-studio-header.md`, `11863-studio-recent-packages.md` and `11863-studio-search.md`, and none of them is made false. "A principal the Studio entry gate refuses never reaches the builder, so records nothing" still holds. No pending changeset names `StudioRoute.tsx`. I also read `11798-console-eager-closure.md`. Its sentence "The Studio entry gate is unchanged and still decides first, so a principal without `studio.access` never downloads the builder" describes that change's own effect, and its facts still hold, so it is not amended.
- **The reused label.** `empty.appAccessDeniedHome` is the label of the app refusal screen this shape copies, and it is "Back to home" in each pack. If that screen's wording ever moves, this one moves with it. The contract review may prefer a dedicated key. That would be a second new key, which the card's ruling does not allow, so it is left to the review.
- `RequireAiSurface` still redirects silently. It is an availability gate, not a refusal, and is out of this card's scope. Nothing is filed.
